name: lgm50
description: LG M50T 21700 (NMC811 / graphite-SiOx, 5 Ah), Kirkaldy et al., J. Power Sources 2024, zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10637534. Expt 4 cells A-H (drive-cycle ageing: WLTP discharge, 0.3C CC-CV charge) and Expt 5 cells A-H (1C discharge, 0.3C CC-CV); A-C at 10 C, D-E at 25 C, F-H at 40 C. Beginning-of-life checks at ~25 C (Expt 4: C/10, C/2, GITT, hybrid pulses; Expt 5: C/10 only, from the processed curves), the first ageing cycles (VAL) at the chamber temperature, 1 s.

C10.note: C/10 (0.5 A) discharge to 2.5 V, 6 h rest, C/10 charge to 4.2 V (no CV)

GITT.note: ~24 x 0.2 A.h discharge pulses at C/2 (2.5 A), each followed by a 1 h rest

C2.note: C/2 discharge to 2.5 V, 6 h rest, C/2 charge to 4.2 V

GITT_C2.note: 1 A.h discharge steps at C/2 with 1 h rests

HYB_C2.note: hybrid CC-pulse discharge: C/2 base with 10 s pulses of +-10..50 %, recorded at 0.1 s

HYB_1C.note: hybrid CC-pulse discharge: 1C base with 10 s pulses of +-10..50 %, recorded at 0.1 s

VAL.note: first ageing cycles at the chamber temperature, from the 4 h rest at the top to the end of the CC-CV after the first full discharge

E4.note: two 1-h WLTP discharges with 0.3C CC-CV recharges, a 0.15 A step, a full WLTP discharge, 0.3C CC-CV

E5.note: 1C discharge, 0.3C CC-CV, 0.15 A discharge to ~3.9 V, 1C discharge to 2.5 V, 0.3C CC-CV
